AIforPsy

Professional AI Photoshoot

Professional photos without a studio or complicated preparation. Show us who you are and tell us what you want to create — or let us help choose your style.

No in-person photoshoot is needed. Everything happens online, using your real photographs.

Choose your way ↓

Your photographs

Upload at least 6 real photographs, ideally more. Your face should be clearly visible. The camera you use matters less than a clear view of your face.

  • Everyday photos, selfies, and pictures from a phone or camera
  • Different expressions, with and without a smile
  • Different angles: straight on, slightly to the side, profile, and head turns

Please don’t use

  • AI-generated images or screenshots
  • Photos taken of a phone or computer screen
  • Heavily distorted or excessively edited pictures
  • Images where your face cannot be seen clearly
Visual examples of suitable source photographs will appear here.

Show us the result you like

Reference images are optional. Show a style, outfit, hairstyle, makeup, pose, background, interior, lighting, or mood — or simply describe your wishes in words.

Let us choose your style

You can skip references entirely. We’ll help you find a look that suits you.

A little about the result

An AI photoshoot can introduce small variations in appearance. With guided packages, we create more options so you can choose photos where you recognize yourself and feel most comfortable with the result.
